indicator_name: CPI: housing and utility services, year-on-year
description: ИПЦ: жилищно-коммунальные услуги, к соответствующему месяцу прошлого года
methodology: Index, same month of the previous year = 100: CPI for housing and utility services (Taldau index 703076, term 4772562), monthly from 2011-01, national. Same index and dictionaries as the headline CPI; December year-on-year values equal BNS element 1548 for 2011-2025.
